Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bimar ho gaye aur ek ya do raton tak aap Tahajjud ki namaz ke liye na uth sake to ek aurat kehne lagi ke tujhe tere shaitan ne chhod diya, is par yeh agli ayatein nazil huin (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). Hazrat Jundub (R.A) farmate hain ke Jibraeel (A.S) ke aane mein kuch der hui to mushrikeen kehne lage ke yeh to chhod diye gaye, to Allah Ta'ala ne 'Wad-Duha' se 'Ma Qala' fa tak ki ayatein utarein. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ungli par patthar mara gaya tha jis se khoon nikla aur jis par aap ne farmaya: "Hal anta illa isba'un damiti, wa fi sabilillahi ma laqiti" yani tu sirf ek ungli hai aur rah-e-Allah mein tujhe yeh zakhm laga hai. Tabiyat kuch nasaz ho jane ki wajah se do teen raat aap bedar na hue jis par us aurat ne woh nashaista alfaz nikale aur yeh ayatein nazil huin. Kaha gaya hai ke yeh aurat Abu Lahab ki biwi Umm-e-Jameel thi, is par Allah ki maar. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ungli ka zakhmi hona, aur is mauzoon kalam ka besakhta zaban-e-mubarak se ada hona to Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi sabit hai lekin tark-e-qayam ka sabab ise batana aur is par in ayaton ka nazil hona yeh ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ne kaha tha ke aap ka Rabb aap se kahin naraz to nahin ho gaya? Is par yeh ayatein utrein. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jibraeel (A.S) ke aane mein der hui, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bahut ghabraye, is par Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ne yeh sabab bayan kiya aur is par yeh ayatein utrein. Yeh dono ayatein mursal hain aur Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ka naam to is mein mehfooz nahin maloom hota, haan yeh mumkin hai ke Umm-ul-Momineen ne afsos aur ranj ke sath yeh farmaya, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Ishaq aur ba'az salaf ne farmaya hai ke jab Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) apni asli surat mein zahir hue the aur bahut hi qareeb ho gaye the us waqt isi surat ki wahi nazil farmayi thi. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke wahi ke ruk jane ki bina par mushrikeen ke is napak qaul ki tardeed mein yeh ayatein utrein. Yahan Allah Ta'ala ne dhoop padhne ke waqt din ki roshni, aur raat ke sukoon aur andhere ki qasam khayi jo qudrat aur khalq-e-Khaliq ki saaf daleel hai. Jaise aur jagah hai: (Wal-laili iza yaghsha) (Surah Al-Lail: 1). Aur jagah hai: (Faliqul-isbah) (Surah Al-An'am: 96), matlab yeh hai ke apni is qudrat ka yahan bhi bayan kiya hai. Phir farmata hai ke tere Rabb ne na to tujhe chhod diya na tujh se dushmani ki, tere liye aakhirat is duniya se bahut behtar hai. Isi liye Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) duniya mein sab se zyada zahid the. Aur sab se zyada tarik-e-duniya the, aap ki seerat ka mutala karne wale par yeh baat hargiz makhfi nahin reh sakti. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) boriye par soye, jism-e-mubarak par boriye ke nishan pad gaye. Jab bedar hue to main aap ki karwat par hath pherne laga aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein kyun ijazat nahin dete ke is boriye par kuch bicha diya karein.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe duniya se kya wasta? Main kahan duniya kahan? Meri aur duniya ki misaal toh us rahro-e-sawar ki tarah hai jo kisi darakht talay zara si der thehar jaye phir usay chhor kar chal day. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur hasan hai phir farmaya tera Rab tujhay aakhirat mein teri ummat ke baray mein is qadar ne'matein dega ke khush hojaye un ki bari takreem hogi aur Aap ko khaas kar ke Hauz-e-Kausar ata farmaya jaye ga. Jis ke kinaray khokhlay motiyon ke khaimay honge jis ki mitti khalis mushk ki hogi, yeh hadeesein anqareeb aa rahi hain. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Ek riwayat mein hai ke jo khazanay Aap ki ummat ko milnay walay thay woh ek ek kar ke Aap ko bata diye gaye. Aap bohat khush huay is par yeh aayat utri. Jab ek hazaar mahal Aap ko diye gaye har har mahal mein paak biwiyan aur behtareen ghulam hain. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) tak is ki sanad sahih hai aur ba-zahir aisi baat baghair Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sunay riwayat nahin ho sakti. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki razamandi mein se yeh bhi hai ke Aap ke Ahl-e-Bait mein se koi dozakh mein na jaye. Hasan (R.H) farmatay hain is se murad shafa'at hai. Ibn-e-Abi Shaiba mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hum woh log hain jin ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne aakhirat duniya par pasand kar li hai, phir Aap ne aayat "Wa-lasawfa" ki tilawat farmayi. Ke Aap ki yateemi ki halat mein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne Aap ka bachao kiya. Aur Aap ki hifazat ki aur parwarish ki aur maqam-o-martaba inayat farmaya. Aap ke walid ka inteqal toh Aap ki paidaish se pehlay hi ho chuka tha ba'az kehtay hain wiladat ke baad hua chhay saal ki umar mein walida sahiba ka bhi inteqal ho gaya. Ab Aap dada ki kafalat mein thay lekin jab aath saal ki Aap ki umar hui toh dada ka saya bhi uth gaya. Ab Aap apnay chacha Abu Talib ki parwarish mein aaye, Abu Talib dil-o-jaan se Aap ki nigrani aur imdad mein rahay. Aap ki poori izzat-o-tauqeer kartay aur qoum ki mukhalifat ke charhtay toofan ko roktay rehtay thay aur apni jaan ko bator-e-dhaal ke pesh kar diya kartay thay. Kyunke chalees saal ki umar mein Aap ko nabuwwat mil chuki thi aur Quraish sakht tar mukhalifat balkay dushman-e-jaan ho gaye thay Abu Talib bawajood but parast mushrik honay ke Aap ka saath deta tha. Aur mukhalifeen se larta bharta rehta tha. Yeh thi minjanib-e-Allah husn-e-tadbeer ke Aap ki yateemi ke ayyam isi tarah guzray aur mukhalifeen se Aap ki khidmat is tarah li, yahan tak ke hijrat se kuch pehlay Abu Talib bhi faut ho gaye, ab sufaha-o-juhala Quraish uth kharay huay toh Parwardigar-e-Aalam ne Aap ko Madina tashreef ki taraf hijrat karnay ki rukhsat ata farmayi aur Aus-o-Khazraj jaisi qoumon ko Aap ka ansar bana diya. In buzurgon ne Aap ko aur Aap ke sathiyon ko jagah di. Madad ki, hifazat ki aur mukhalifeen se seena-sipar ho kar mardana-war laraiyan keen. Allah un sab se khush rahay. Yeh sab ka sab Allah ki hifazat aur us ki inayat ehsan aur ikram se tha.

Phir farmaya ke raah bhoola paakar sahih raasta dikha diya jaise aur jagah hai Ma kunta tadri mal-kitabu walal-iman (42:52) ya'ni isi tarah hum ne apne hukm se tumhari taraf rooh ki wahi ki. Tum yeh bhi nahin jaante the ke iman kya hai? Tumhein na kitab ki khabar thi balkeh hum ne ise noor bana kar jise chaha hidayat kardi. Ba'az kehte hain ke murad yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bachpan mein Makkah ki galiyon mein gum ho gaye the us waqt Allah ne lauta diya. Ba'az kehte hain Shaam ki taraf apne chacha ke saath jaate hue raat ko shaitan ne aap ki oontni ki nakeel pakar kar raah se hata kar jungle mein daal diya. Pas Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) aaye aur phoonk maar kar shaitan ko to Habsha mein daal diya aur sawari ko raah laga diya. Baghawi ne yeh dono qaul naqal kiye hain phir farmata hai ke baal bachon waale hote hue tang-dast paakar hum ne aap ko ghani kar diya, pas faqir sabir aur ghani shakir hone ke darajat aap ko mil gaye. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain yeh sab haal nabuwat se pehle ke hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tawangari maal-o-asbab ki ziyadati se nahin balkeh haqiqi tawangari woh hai jis ka dil be-parwah ho. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai us ne falah paali jise Islam naseeb hua aur jo kafi hua, itna rizq bhi mila Allah ke diye hue par qana'at ki taufiq bhi mili, phir farmaya hai ke yateem ko haqeer jaan kar na daant dupt kar balkeh us ke saath ehsan-o-sulook kar aur apni yateemi ko na bhool, Qatada farmate hain yateem ke liye aisa ho jana chahiye jaise saga baap aulad par meharban hota hai, sa'il ko na jhirak jis tarah tum be-raah the aur Allah ne hidayat di to ab jo tum se ilmi baatein pooche sahih raasta daryaft kare to tum use daant dupt na karo, ghareeb maskeen za'eef bandon par takabbur-o-tajabbur na karo, unhein daanto dupto nahin bura bhala na kaho sakht sust na bolo, agar maskeen ko kuch na karo, to bhi bhala achha jawab de. Narmi aur raham ka sulook kar, phir farmaya ke apne Rab ki ne'matein bayan karte raho. Ya'ni jis tarah tumhari faqiri ko hum ne tawangari se badal diya, tum bhi hamari in ne'maton ko bayan karte raho, isi liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki duaon mein yeh bhi tha Waj'alna shakireena li-ni'matika muthneena biha 'alaika qabiliha wa atimmaha 'alaina ya'ni Allah hamein apni ne'maton ki shukr-guzari karne wala un ki wajah se teri sana bayan karne wala un ka iqrar karne wala karde aur in ne'maton ko hum par poora karde. Abu Nazra farmate hain ke musalmanon ka yeh khayal tha ke ne'maton ki shukr-guzari mein yeh bhi dakhil hai ke un ka bayan ho, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai jis ne thore par shukr na ada kiya us ne zyada par bhi shukr nahin kiya. Jis ne logon ki shukr-guzari na ki us ne Allah ka shukr bhi ada nahin kiya. Ne'maton ka bayan bhi shukr hai aur un ka bayan na karna bhi nashukri hai, jama'at ke saath rehna rahmat ka sabab hai aur tafriqa azab ka ba'is hai, is ki asnad za'eef hai.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Anas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Muhajireen ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Ansar sara ka sara ajar le gaye. Farmaya nahin, jab tak ke tum un ke liye dua kiya karo aur un ki tareef karte raho. Abu Dawood mein hai, us ne Allah ka shukr ada na kiya jis ne bandon ka shukr ada na kiya. Abu Dawood ki hadith mein hai ke jise koi naimat mili aur us ne use bayan kiya to woh shukr-guzar hai aur jis ne use chupaya us ne nashukri ki. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jise koi atiya diya jaye use chahiye ke agar ho sake to badla utaar de, agar na ho sake to us ki sana bayan kare. Jis ne sana ki woh shukr-guzar hua aur jis ne us naimat ka izhar na kiya us ne nashukri ki. (Abu Dawood). Mujahid farmate hain yahan naimat se murad Nabuwwat hai, ek riwayat mein hai ke Quran murad hai, Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jo bhalai ki baatein aap ko maloom hain woh apne bhaiyon se bhi bayan karo, Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) kehte hain jo naimat-o-karamat Nabuwwat ki tumhein mili hai use bayan karo, us ka zikr karo aur us ki taraf logon ko dawat do. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne walon mein se jin par aap ko itminan hota dar-parda sab se pehle pehal dawat deni shuru ki aur aap par namaz farz hui jo aap ne ada ki. Surah Ad-Duha ki tafsir khatam hui, Allah ke ehsan par us ka shukr hai.
